items.prompt: What is estimator bias under the stated sampling model?

options.text: The error in whichever sample was most recently observed
options.why: One realized error is not an expectation over samples.
The expectation averages the random estimator under its sampling distribution.

options.text: Always the square root of sample variance
options.why: That describes neither bias nor its sign.

options.text: A guarantee that every result is wrong in the same direction
options.why: A biased estimator can still produce errors in either direction.

items.explanation: Bias belongs to an estimator and a sampling model; it cannot usually be inferred from a single realized estimate.
